findings.title: Content stays invisible after scrolling the whole page
findings.evidence: 4 text/image elements still have opacity≈0 after a full scroll: details.qa.is-in > div.qa-body > div > p "RTP, FedNow, ACH, wires, SEPA (credit transfer and Instant),"; details.qa.is-in > div.qa-body > div > p "Yes. Import historical entries in bulk with their original t"; details.qa.is-in > div.qa-body > div > p "Writes keep committing on the remaining two regions. In-flig"; details.qa.is-in > div.qa-body > div > p "The sandbox runs the same code path as production with simul".
findings.fix: A reveal never fired. Check the IntersectionObserver targets/threshold (use threshold ≤0.15 and a negative bottom rootMargin, not 1.0), that every hidden element gets observed, and gate the hidden initial state behind a class added by JS (`.js [data-reveal]{opacity:0}`) so content is never lost if script fails.

findings.title: Text contrast is too low
findings.evidence: 24/244 checked text elements fail WCAG AA, e.g. "Trusted by the engineering teams behind" 3.35:1, "Python" 3.31:1, "cURL" 3.31:1.
findings.fix: Muted text still needs ≥4.5:1 (≥3:1 for 24px+). Raise lightness contrast of secondary text instead of lowering opacity.

findings.title: Entrance sequence is long
findings.fix: Keep the hero sequence ≲1.6 s from first paint to settled; shorten delays rather than durations. Visitors should be able to read the headline within ~600 ms.

findings.title: Layout properties are animated
findings.evidence: 76 animations/transitions on width, height, marginTop, margin-top, max-height; 0 inline-style layout writes.
findings.fix: Animate transform and opacity (and clip-path for reveals) instead of width/height/top/left/margin; they run on the compositor and avoid reflow jank. For accordions use grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr or measure once and animate a scale/clip.

findings.title: Hover feedback is sluggish
findings.evidence: 3 hover transitions last over 600 ms (e.g. header#nav > div.wrap.nav-inner > div.nav-cta > a.btn.btn-lime::after: 900 ms).
findings.fix: Hover/press feedback should start immediately and settle in 150–300ms; longer feels laggy under the pointer.

findings.title: Many elements loop forever
findings.fix: Limit ambient loops to one or two focal elements (a hero visual, a marquee). Constant motion everywhere competes with content and drains battery; pause off-screen loops.

findings.title: Tap targets are small on mobile
findings.evidence: div.wrap.hero-grid > div.hero-copy > div.install > button.copy 34×34, button#ledgerToggle 28×28, div#term > div.term-bar > div.tabs > button 51×33, div#term > div.term-bar > div.tabs > button 67×33
findings.fix: Give touch controls at least 44×44px of hit area (padding or a pseudo-element hit box).

findings.title: Body text is small on mobile
Code is cut off at the panel edge
findings.evidence: mobile scrollY 6533px: code is cut off at the box edge
findings.fix: Let long lines scroll (overflow-x:auto with a visible fade) or wrap them, and size the sample so its longest line fits; on phones, shorten the sample.

findings.title: The page looks like the default AI-built template
findings.evidence: It shares 6 of 9 traits of the landing page coding agents build by default: text face Geist, italic accent word in the headline, near-black ground, small uppercase eyebrow above the headline, headline left, object right, marquee.
findings.fix: Unless the brief asks for these, change at least four: a display face chosen for this subject, a ground and accent taken from its world, a hero built around one dominant element instead of headline-left/object-right, square or cut button shapes, and sections laid out from their content rather than eyebrow, marquee and bento. A page can earn every trait; it should not get them by default.
